Hi Rishi — thanks again for the demo last week. The engineering team at OpsBot is excited to get a hands-on sprint scheduled (prompt tuning + routing tests + a short load test). Two constraints from our side:

- ETA: we need the working session before the end of May to align with our release cadence.
- Quotas: we'll likely ask for a temporary quota bump for burst testing (~2M tokens/day for 48 hours).

Available windows (PST):
- Tue 5/18 afternoon (1:00–4:00pm)
- Wed 5/19 morning (9:00–11:30am)
- Fri 5/21 full day (flexible)

Can you confirm which slot works and whether Redwood can support the short quota bump + dedicated routing profile during the test? I attached our internal checklist (see attachment list) and a token budget estimate.

Thanks — Taylor
Taylor Lee | Head of Platform Ops, OpsBot

Thanks Taylor — all useful context. Quick notes from our side:

- We're good to run a 3–4 hour hands-on session that covers prompt review, routing rules, and a focused load test.
- For the short quota bump: we need an internal approval window. If the spike is limited to 48 hours and tied to a controlled test, we can usually approve a temporary increase on Dedicated trials. For Hosted trials, we generally route burst tests to a higher-capacity pool with slightly different cost/latency profiles.

Can you confirm which trial mode you're on (Hosted API trial vs Dedicated reserved)? That determines what is feasible for the quota bump and routing policy.

Agenda proposal (we can trim):
- 15m: Kickoff + success criteria (Marissa)
- 45m: Prompt walkthrough + best-practices for prefix caching (Karthik)
- 60m: Routing & model variant mapping (Rishi)
- 45m: Controlled load test & token-budget validation
- 15m: Next steps / rollouts / canary plan

I'm tentatively blocking Wed 5/19 09:00–13:00 PT. If that works, Marissa will send a calendar invite and a short pre-read (runbook + doc link).

- Rishi
